entries.0df593dbdd8a7bb2: This is the core business of the group (revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥523,615 million). In Japan, it sells medical devices for injection and infusion, artificial organs, high-function products, and dialysis, as well as pharmaceuticals related to diabetes, generics, and kit preparations. Overseas, it has manufacturing and sales bases and sells medical devices for injection and infusion, artificial organs, and diabetes.
entries.0f6719befc181188: This business contracts manufacturing of pharmaceuticals from pharmaceutical companies (revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥81,107 million). In addition to contract sales of pharmaceuticals associated with kit preparation containers, a domestic subsidiary manufactures and sells injectable preparations, various oral preparations, and kit preparations. Contract work for anticancer agents and syringe preparations is increasing.

entries.23c28c183c6e11ce: In May 2025 it formulated a 3-year medium-term management plan running through fiscal 2027, and it promotes “profit-focused management,” which emphasizes profitability in addition to scale expansion. As management strategy, it lists efficiency through integrated development, manufacturing and sales operations and optimization of its cost structure; strengthening the global rollout of high-quality, high-function products developed in Japan and a supply system for local production for local consumption; initiatives in next-generation medical fields; and focused allocation of management resources through selection and concentration.
